title: A change with a consequence (hides, site-wide, 6+ places, a price; EmDash unpublish/menu/settings; design system apply; known shell writes) answers CONFIRM_FIRST and runs once after the customer's yes to the door's own card
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: pnpm --filter @tracy/dsh-site-tools build (the wiring tests load lib/index.js).
S2: Run the run.cmd below (node --test over the consequence, shell, call-memory, EmDash, design-route, handler, tiers, voice-reply and page.create suites; no stand, no model).
S3: Read the exit code and the pass/fail counts.
expect: content.update to draft/trash (WordPress) or state 0/2/-2 (Joomla) answers CONFIRM_FIRST consequence 'hides'; Joomla featured:0 runs at once; look.set scope site, theme.style, a site.identity set answer 'site'; content.replace over 6 places answers 'many' with count 6 and writes nothing, 5 places run; a replace that changes 120.000d to 150.000d answers 'price' with both amounts as facts.

EmDash content_unpublish, menu_set_items and settings_update answer CONFIRM_FIRST; the agent's own confirm:true opens nothing; after the yes to the card one call runs and the next asks again; page.create's own menu row does not ask.
tracy_design_system apply with the switch off is refused before any question; with it on it asks, and after the yes reaches the door with the person's headers.
An ask_user_question card whose question leaves out a stored fact is denied before it is shown; a yes older than 5 minutes opens nothing.

bash 'wp post delete 12 --force' is denied with a confirm- card and the tracy_site content.delete door named; after the yes the same command is allowed once, a second time is denied, another id is denied; reads, dry runs and SELECTs run.
evidence: Council 17/10/2026 (P0 of Voice: a misheard request must not become a change to the site) and 19/10/2026 (scope by consequence for every channel, host-held facts, TTL 5 minutes, shell patterns with the gap said). ADR 0034.
fence: The doors' confirm gates, the card check in pre-execute and the shell pattern rule, through the plugin as built. Not exercised: a model choosing to call, a real site, a shell script that writes by itself (the ADR's open gap).
